items.title: Awned Wheat Head
items.alt: A ripe golden wheat head with fine awns stands on a short straw stem beside one curled dry leaf.
items.description: A ripe golden wheat head with fine awns stands on a short straw stem beside one curled dry leaf. Use the complete head and stem for a crop vocabulary card or a seasonal notebook heading.

items.title: Wheat Spikelet Study
items.alt: One detached wheat spikelet has three grain-bearing florets gathered above two outer glumes, with complete slender awns and two loose kernels beside it.
items.description: One detached wheat spikelet has three grain-bearing florets gathered above two outer glumes, with complete slender awns and two loose kernels beside it. Place this detached structure beside a whole head when introducing spikelets and florets.

items.title: Wheat Kernels with Visible Creases
items.alt: Three amber wheat kernels show a lengthwise crease, a rounded back and a fine brush of hairs at one tip.
items.description: Three amber wheat kernels show a lengthwise crease, a rounded back and a fine brush of hairs at one tip. The different seed views suit a classroom observation page about grain shape.

items.title: Germinating Wheat Kernel
items.alt: One wheat kernel has a pale green coleoptile curving upward and several white roots extending from its embryo end.
items.description: One wheat kernel has a pale green coleoptile curving upward and several white roots extending from its embryo end. Leave space beside the emerging root and shoot for your own germination notes.

items.title: Young Wheat Seedling with Roots
items.alt: A young wheat seedling has three narrow green leaves, a visible kernel and branching fibrous roots in a small soil cutaway.
items.description: A young wheat seedling has three narrow green leaves, a visible kernel and branching fibrous roots in a small soil cutaway. Use the visible roots and leaves in a personal plant-growth journal.

items.title: Tillering Wheat Plant
items.alt: A young wheat plant has a tall central leafy shoot and smaller side shoots joining at a fibrous root crown.
items.description: A young wheat plant has a tall central leafy shoot and smaller side shoots joining at a fibrous root crown. The main shoot and side shoots can support a classroom discussion of tillering.
